messages:
omar: Heads-up — staged-release 1.12.3 is showing a perf regression on short-sequence p99 after the kernel-selector changes landed. Blocking rollout until we root cause.
ci-perf-bot: [automated] perf-check: nightly/runtime/short-seq p99 increased +28% vs baseline (threshold 10%). Log: https://perf.redwood/internal/12345 :warning:
maya: ugh. noticed that in synthetic runs earlier but thought it was noise. thanks for flagging.
sasha: which metric exactly? end-to-end latency or token-loop?
omar: end-to-end tail (p99 request latency for <=16 tokens). token loop shows extra stalls at kv get path.
lena: can you paste profiler flame?
omar: here, grabbed a quick async profile during the failing run:
```
# folded stack samples
runtime::dispatch_kernel_for_len(16) -> kernel_selector::choose()
kv_cache::read_prefetch -> io::read_batch -> kernel_executor::prepare_state
kv_cache::metrics::miss_handler
```
looks like selector is picking a kernel variant that forces extra KV prefetch calls for short sequences.
eric: that matches my local repro — after the new kernel hint heuristic (#PR-482) we try a vectorized kernel that expects an eager kv prefetch, which spikes IO on half the requests.
sasha: hmm. PR-482 changed heuristic to prefer fewer kernel launches even if it increases prefetch size. tradeoff failed for short sequences.
maya: can we gate the staged rollout by sequence-length distribution? i.e., auto-fallback to old selector if short-seq p99 > SLO?
lena: we have an autoslo monitor but it triggers at route-level, not by sequence bucket. We could add a short-seq guard, but that’s more change.
ci-perf-bot: detailed diffs: kernel-selector: +prefetch-weighting flag enabled in release; batching heuristic unchanged.
omar: immediate mitigation: pause staged-release and toggle `kernel_selector.prefetch_weighting=false` via feature flag. Ops — can you hold the rollout? @devops-bot
devops-bot: Received request: pause rollout for release 1.12.3. Executing toggle.
ci-perf-bot: rollback not required yet. quick flip applied to 10%->0% rollout. Re-evaluating.
eric: flipping flag locally reduces p99 ~ back to baseline. re-run CI perf?
ci-perf-bot: kicked off perf/regression job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/rt-perf-1789. Estimated 18m.
sasha: while CI runs, I'd like to run a bisect on PR-482 to isolate exact line that increased prefetch calls. I can add microbench harness for selector with synthetic seq dist.
maya: also add an observability probe for kv-prefetch-size histogram by sequence length bucket. then the autoslo can watch that.
lena: filed an observability ticket: OBS-987. I'll wire the histogram to the SLO alerting as a short-term guard (alert -> pause rollout playbook).
omar: good. priority: 1) pause rollout (done), 2) confirm ci perf job, 3) bisect PR-482 + microbench, 4) add short-seq SLO guard, 5) consider selector fallback policy for short sequences.
eric: timeline: I can do the bisect + microbench in next 2 hours, sasha can review.
sasha: i'll prep a minimal revert PR if bisect points to a single line. keep changes small.
maya: long term idea: autosafe rollout policy that keeps per-bucket SLOs and an automated fallback to previous model/selector variant for affected buckets only. not whole service. call it "auto-failsafe shards". :bulb:
omar: love that. skirts full rollback and reduces blast radius. can we prototype with a route flag?
lena: yep, we can map sequence-length buckets to rollout shards and attach independent health checks. implementation complexity moderate.
ci-perf-bot: perf job finished: short-seq p99 delta now +2% after flag flip (within threshold).
eric: great — perf validated. finishing bisect now.
sasha: found culprit in PR-482: selector comparator used `estimated_io_cost * prefetch_multiplier` without normalizing by sequence_len -> overweighted prefetch for short sequences. sending revert-fix PR that divides by max(1, seq_len_scale).
omar: approved for hotfix. please include microbench and a unit test for small seqs.
sasha: will do.
maya: after hotfix we should resume staged-release with a tighter auto-fail policy: if short-seq p99 +5% -> auto-pause and toggle fallback selector for that shard.
lena: noted. I'll update the rollout playbook and add the shard fallback step. Playbook PR: infra/playbooks/rollout-autoguard.md
omar: thanks everyone. once hotfix merges, devops, resume gradual rollout at 1% and let autoslo watch.
devops-bot: Acknowledge. Resume schedule queued pending merge.
ci-perf-bot: closing thread — follow-ups tracked in OBS-987 and PR-490 (hotfix). :white_check_mark:
